name: Ethoxylated canola oil amide hydroxyethyl
description: Ethoxylated canola oil amide hydroxyethyl (CAS 827613-35-4 ) is a nonionic surfactant derived from canola oil fatty acids through amidation and ethoxylation. It functions as an emulsifier, dispersant, and cleaning agent across a range of industrial and consumer formulations. In textile and leather processing, it emulsifies oils and lubricants in scouring and softening baths, improving fiber wettability and process consistency. Industrial and household cleaning formulations use it as a degreasing surfactant. This material maintains stability across varying pH conditions and water hardness levels. In personal care, its humectant character supports moisturizing creams, lotions, and conditioning rinses where a bio-based emulsifier is preferred. Agricultural formulations incorporate it as an emulsifier and dispersant in crop protection concentrates. This improves active ingredient distribution and spray coverage, ensuring more effective application in various environmental conditions. Ethoxylated canola oil amide hydroxyethyl is typically supplied as a liquid or viscous paste. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, with ethoxylation degree varying by supplier to target specific HLB ranges. Buyers should confirm ethylene oxide mole content and active matter concentration when evaluating lots for formulation compatibility.
